entities.name: Muhammed Fuad Abdülbaki
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Muḥammad Fu'ād ʿAbd al-Baqī was a prolific Egyptian scholar of Islam, a poet and a translator from French and English. He wrote and compiled many books related to the Qur'an and the sunnah, including indices which give the reader access to the hadith of the Islamic prophet Muhammad.

entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Muḥammad Fu'ād ʿAbd al-Baqī was a prolific Egyptian scholar of Islam, a poet and a translator from French and English. He wrote and compiled many books related to the Qur'an and the sunnah, including indices which give the reader access to the hadith of the Islamic prophet Muhammad.
